patterns.note: Content sections alternate between dark grey and light grey/white backgrounds to visually separate distinct content blocks and create rhythm.
Product category navigation uses a horizontal grid of icon cards, allowing users to browse types of devices at a glance.
Key product names and section titles use a large, bold sans-serif typeface for strong visual hierarchy and impact.
A high-contrast palette of dark grey, white, and a vibrant red/orange is used, with red/orange consistently marking calls to action and key highlights.
The hero section features a subtle parallax effect where the background image scrolls slower than the foreground content, creating a sense of depth.
The primary navigation bar remains fixed at the top of the viewport as the user scrolls down the page, providing persistent access.

technique_notes: The hero section employs a background image that moves at a slower rate than the foreground content during vertical scrolling, creating a subtle parallax depth effect. Other content sections reveal by simply scrolling into the viewport without complex fade-ins or slide-ups. The main navigation bar is fixed to the top of the screen, maintaining its position throughout the scroll.

design_tokens.type_scale: Large, bold sans-serif headings (approx. 3-4x body size) provide strong visual impact, complemented by smaller, regular weight body text and uppercase labels.
design_tokens.radius: Subtle rounded corners (small radius) are applied to buttons, product cards, and input fields, softening the overall aesthetic.
design_tokens.spacing: A balanced spacing system is used, with generous vertical spacing between major sections and a tighter grid for product displays and informational cards.

standout: The site's design stands out with its bold, high-contrast aesthetic, combining dark, immersive photography with vibrant red/orange accents. This creates a premium, adventurous feel that effectively highlights products without relying on overly complex animations or layouts, making it distinctive from generic templates.
